title: Which to Believe: Trump’s Words, or His Acts?

sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Secretary of State Mike Pompeo testifies before the Senate.
sentences.zh: 今天，国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥在参议院作证。

sentences.en: At question, what is actually U.S.
sentences.zh: 核心问题是，美国对俄罗斯的政策

sentences.en: policy toward Russia?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么？

sentences.en: What the president says?
sentences.zh: 是总统所说的那些？

sentences.en: Or what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还是美国

sentences.en: government does?
sentences.zh: 政府实际做的那些？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: Julie, what was the origin of Wednesday's hearing?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，周三这场听证会的起因是什么？

sentences.en: Well, so the Senate Foreign Relations Committee wanted to call the Secretary of State to talk about the administration's recent foreign policy moves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，参议院外交关系委员会想要传唤国务卿，来谈谈政府近期的外交政策举措。

sentences.en: Julie Davis covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯负责为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: So this wasn't, you know, your routine invitation to a Secretary of State.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是那种常规的国务卿受邀出席。

sentences.en: It's pretty unusual.
sentences.zh: 这相当不寻常。

sentences.en: And then after the invitation had been extended, of course, we had this summit last week that President Trump had with President Putin in Helsinki, Finland.
sentences.zh: 而且在发出邀请之后，当然，上周特朗普总统和普京总统在芬兰赫尔辛基举行了峰会。

sentences.en: They all had a lot of questions that they wanted to ask Mike Pompeo about what went on in that room.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多问题想问迈克·蓬佩奥，关于那间屋子里到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And that got added to the agenda of this hearing.
sentences.zh: 于是这也被加进了听证会的议程。

sentences.en: And it becomes really a chance for the senators to question the Secretary of State, who used to be a member of Congress, about what is really going on here.
sentences.zh: 这实际上成了参议员们质询国务卿的机会，而他本人也曾是国会议员，他们想问问这里到底在发生什么。

sentences.en: Foreign Relations Committee will come to order.
sentences.zh: 外交关系委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: So it begins with, you know, opening statements from the chairman of the committee and the ranking Democrat.
sentences.zh: 听证会以委员会主席和民主党领袖的开场陈词开始。

sentences.en: Secretary Pompeo,
sentences.zh: 蓬佩奥国务卿，

sentences.en: we are glad to have you here today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你今天能来。

sentences.en: We're grateful for your service to our country.
sentences.zh: 我们感谢你为国家所做的贡献。

sentences.en: I have faith in your leadership, and I appreciate what you're doing to change the culture of the State Department in positive ways.
sentences.zh: 我对你的领导能力充满信心，也赞赏你为以积极方式改变国务院文化所做的努力。

sentences.en: But I want to get straight to the point.
sentences.zh: 但我想要直奔主题。

sentences.en: You come before a group of senators today who are filled with serious doubts about this White House and its conduct of American foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 你今天面对的是一群参议员，他们对本届白宫及其执行美国外交政策的方式充满了严重的怀疑。

sentences.en: Essentially, Bob Corker, the chairman of the committee, who is a Republican, but he's very outspoken and he is retiring, basically says that...
sentences.zh: 本质上，委员会主席鲍勃·科克，他虽然是共和党人，但非常直言不讳，而且即将退休，他基本上说……

sentences.en: I can't say it more forcefully.
sentences.zh: 我无法用更强硬的措辞来表达了。

sentences.en: We really need a clear understanding as to what is going on, what our president is agreeing to, and what our strategy is on a number of issues.
sentences.zh: 我们确实需要明确了解到底发生了什么，总统同意了什么，以及我们在诸多问题上的战略是什么。

sentences.en: After the summit, we saw an American president who was submissive to Putin, who was deferential to him.
sentences.zh: 峰会之后，我们看到了一位对普京唯唯诺诺、表现得毕恭毕敬的美国总统。

sentences.en: Last week, President Trump held a summit with Vladimir Putin, someone who has violated the most fundamental international norms through his efforts to annex Crimea,
sentences.zh: 上周，特朗普总统与弗拉基米尔·普京举行了峰会，此人通过吞并克里米亚的行径，违反了最基本的国际准则，

sentences.en: has interfered with elections, including our own, has supported the brutal Assad regime in Syria, has used chemical weapons to poison a Russian agent
sentences.zh: 干预了包括我们自己在内的多国选举，支持叙利亚残酷的阿萨德政权，使用化学武器毒害俄罗斯特工

sentences.en: and his daughter in the United Kingdom, has occupied portions of Georgia, continues to violate the INF Treaty, has reportedly hacked U.S.
sentences.zh: 及其在英国的女儿，占领了格鲁吉亚部分地区，持续违反《中导条约》，据报道还黑进了美国

sentences.en: utilities.
sentences.zh: 公用事业系统。

sentences.en: The list goes on and on, and you know the liSt.
sentences.zh: 这份名单长得数不胜数，而你是知道这份名单的。

sentences.en: In the face of these hostilities, in the summit's aftermath, we saw an American president who appeared submissive and deferential.
sentences.zh: 面对这些敌对行径，在峰会结束后，我们看到了一位显得唯唯诺诺、毕恭毕敬的美国总统。

sentences.en: So they start out on this very confrontational foot where he's essentially challenging Mike Pompeo to help explain what are we actually seeing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们以这种极具对抗性的姿态开场，他本质上是在挑战迈克·蓬佩奥，让他帮忙解释我们到底看到了什么。

sentences.en: As you know, senators have gone to the White House in groups to discuss these actions, and not a single person that I'm aware of has left those meetings
sentences.zh: 如你所知，参议员们曾分组前往白宫讨论这些行动，据我所知，没有一个人在离开那些会议时

sentences.en: with the sense that there's a coherent strategy driving these policies.
sentences.zh: 觉得这些政策背后存在连贯的战略。

sentences.en: The administration tells us, don't worry, be patient.
sentences.zh: 政府告诉我们，别担心，要有耐心。

sentences.en: There's a strategy here.
sentences.zh: 这里是有战略的。

sentences.en: But from where we sit, it appears that in a ready, fire, aim fashion, the White House is waking up every morning and making it up as they go.
sentences.zh: 但在我们看来，白宫似乎每天醒来都在采取一种“准备、开火、瞄准”的方式，边做边编。

sentences.en: And then Bob Menendez, the senior Democrat on the committee, kind of picks up where Corker leaves off.
sentences.zh: 然后委员会资深民主党人鲍勃·梅嫩德斯接着科克的话继续说。

sentences.en: I remain deeply concerned by the administration's incoherent and contradictory views.
sentences.zh: 我仍然对政府前后矛盾、逻辑不通的观点深感担忧。

sentences.en: We need comprehensive strategies across the world because the result of the lack thereof is chaos and confusion, or even worse.
sentences.zh: 我们需要全球性的综合战略，因为缺乏战略的结果就是混乱和困惑，甚至更糟。

sentences.en: I recognize the president considers himself to be a masterful dealmaker and a very stable genius.
sentences.zh: 我承认总统认为自己是一位精明的交易者和非常稳定的天才。

sentences.en: But we need to call the president's statements out for what they are.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要指出总统言论的本质。

sentences.en: At this point, I find them to be misleading and untruthful.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我认为这些言论具有误导性且不真实。

sentences.en: So I look forward to your testimony to find out what the truth really is.
sentences.zh: 所以我期待你的证词，以查明真相究竟是什么。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's pretty clear from the outset that Mike Pompeo has a lot of explaining to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，从一开始就很清楚，迈克·蓬佩奥有很多解释要做。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, Chairman Corker,
sentences.zh: 下午好，科克主席，

sentences.en: Reiki Member Menendez, and distinguished members.
sentences.zh: 梅嫩德斯议员，以及各位尊贵的委员。

sentences.en: Thank you for the opportunity to be with you today.
sentences.zh: 感谢今天能有机会与各位共聚。

sentences.en: And how does Secretary Pompeo react to these opening statements?
sentences.zh: 那么蓬佩奥国务卿对这些开场陈词有何反应？

sentences.en: Well...
I want to assure this committee that the United States does not and will not recognize the Kremlin's purported annexation of Crimea.
sentences.zh: 我想向本委员会保证，美国不承认、也不会承认克里姆林宫对克里米亚所谓的吞并。

sentences.en: We stand together with allies, partners, and the international community in our commitment to Ukraine and its territorial integrity.
sentences.zh: 我们与盟友、伙伴和国际社会站在一起，致力于维护乌克兰及其领土完整。

sentences.en: You know, he kind of right off the bat reads out this declaration that the United States does not recognize the seizure of Crimea, which is, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他一上来就宣读了这份声明，称美国不承认对克里米亚的占领，这，你知道，

sentences.en: was policy during the Obama administration, has been the policy of the Trump administration, but, of course, the president's own statements have cast doubt on it.
sentences.zh: 是奥巴马政府时期的政策，也是特朗普政府的政策，但当然，总统本人的言论对此产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: I would also add that President Trump is well aware of the challenges that Russia poses to the United States and our partners and allies.
sentences.zh: 我还想补充一点，特朗普总统非常清楚俄罗斯对美国以及我们的伙伴和盟友构成的挑战。

sentences.en: And he kind of comes in with this as, like, exhibit A of all of the litany of tough action that this administration has taken against Russia with President Trump at its helm.
sentences.zh: 他把这当作了本届政府在特朗普总统领导下对俄采取的一系列强硬行动的“证据A”。

sentences.en: 213 sanctions on Russian entities and individuals in the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府对俄罗斯实体和个人实施了213项制裁。

sentences.en: 60 Russian spies expelled from the United States of America and the closure of Russia's consulate in Seattle in response to Russia's chemical weapons use in the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 为回应俄罗斯在英国使用化学武器，60名俄罗斯间谍被驱逐出美国，俄罗斯驻西雅图领事馆被关闭。

sentences.en: The closure of Russia's consulate in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 关闭了俄罗斯驻旧金山领事馆。

sentences.en: And what do you think that
sentences.zh: 你认为

sentences.en: Secretary of State Pompeo is trying to do here, particularly with this declaration
sentences.zh: 蓬佩奥国务卿在这里试图做什么，特别是通过这份

sentences.en: about Crimea?
sentences.zh: 关于克里米亚的声明？

sentences.en: And just last week, the Department of Defense, this is after Helsinki, added an additional $200 million in security cooperation funds to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 就在上周，国防部，也就是在赫尔辛基峰会之后，又向乌克兰追加了2亿美元的安全合作资金。

sentences.en: None of this happened for the eight years that preceded President Trump.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统之前的八年里，这些都没有发生过。

sentences.en: It's not enough for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说还不够。

sentences.en: There's a long liSt.
sentences.zh: 还有很长的一份清单。

sentences.en: I'm happy to go through them.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意一一列举。

sentences.en: I'm guessing sometime today
sentences.zh: 我猜今天晚些时候

sentences.en: I'll get that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我会得到那个机会的。

sentences.en: I look forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我很期待。

sentences.en: I think this is part of, essentially, a damage control effort that the president and the White House have been engaged in, and now the rest of the administration
sentences.zh: 我认为这本质上是总统和白宫一直在进行的损害控制工作的一部分，现在政府的其他部门

sentences.en: is also engaged in, to sort of clean up what happened last week in Helsinki.
sentences.zh: 也参与其中，试图清理上周在赫尔辛基发生的事情。

sentences.en: That they understand that they have to make it clear, because the president muddied the waters, where the administration actually stands with regard to Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们明白必须把立场表达清楚，因为总统搅浑了水，让外界不清楚政府在俄罗斯问题上的真实立场。

sentences.en: Finally, I want you to know,
sentences.zh: 最后，我想让你们知道，

sentences.en: President Trump has stated that he accepts our intelligence community's conclusion that Russia meddled in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经声明，他接受我们情报界关于俄罗斯干预2016年大选的结论。

sentences.en: He has a complete and proper understanding of what happened.
sentences.zh: 他完全且正确地理解了所发生的事情。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I briefed him on it for over a year.
sentences.zh: 我向他简报过一年多了。

sentences.en: And that's what ends up dominating the hearing.
sentences.zh: 而这最终成了主导听证会的内容。

sentences.en: So, I'd like to ask you some questions to get to understand what actually happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想问你一些问题，以了解到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Has the president told you what he and President Putin discussed in their two-hour closed-door meeting in Helsinki?
sentences.zh: 总统有没有告诉你，他和普京总统在赫尔辛基那场两小时的闭门会议中讨论了什么？

sentences.en: So, the questioning starts with Bob Menendez, and he just starts in with very specific questions about what transpired in this meeting.
sentences.zh: 所以，质询从鲍勃·梅嫩德斯开始，他直接切入正题，询问会议中到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: The presidents have a prerogative of choose who's in meetings or not.
sentences.zh: 总统有权选择谁参加会议，谁不参加。

sentences.en: I'm confident you've had private one-on-one meetings in your life as well.
sentences.zh: 我相信你一生中也进行过私下的单独会谈。

sentences.en: You've chosen that setting as the most efficient way to...
sentences.zh: 你选择那种场合作为最有效的方式来……

sentences.en: I just asked you a simple question.
sentences.zh: 我只是问了你一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: Did you...
sentences.zh: 你有没有……

sentences.en: I juSt...
sentences.zh: 我只是……

sentences.en: You can't eat up my seven minutes,
sentences.zh: 你不能占用我的七分钟时间，

sentences.en: Mr. Secretary.
sentences.zh: 国务卿先生。

sentences.en: Did you...
sentences.zh: 你有没有……

sentences.en: Did he tell you whether or not what happened in those two hours?
sentences.zh: 他有没有告诉你那两个小时里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yes, Senator.
sentences.zh: 是的，参议员。

sentences.en: The predicate of your question implied some notion that there was something improper about having a one-on-one meeting.
sentences.zh: 你问题的前提暗示了进行一对一会谈有什么不妥之处。

sentences.en: I completely disagree with the premise of the question.
sentences.zh: 我完全不同意这个问题的假设。

sentences.en: I didn't ask you a predicate.
sentences.zh: 我没有问你前提。

sentences.en: I asked you a simple question.
sentences.zh: 我问的是一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: I hope we're going to get through it.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能谈下去。

sentences.en: Did he tell you what transpired in the two-hour meeting?
sentences.zh: 他有没有告诉你那场两小时的会议中发生了什么？

sentences.en: I had a number of conversations with President Trump about what transpired in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我和特朗普总统就会议内容进行了多次交谈。

sentences.en: And Pompeo takes instant umbrage at that.
sentences.zh: 蓬佩奥对此立刻感到被冒犯了。

sentences.en: Did the president at this meeting call upon President Putin to withdraw from Crimea and eastern Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 总统在这次会议上是否呼吁普京总统从克里米亚和乌克兰东部撤军？

sentences.en: Senator, I began my statement today with the United States government's policy...
sentences.zh: 参议员，我今天开场陈词时就阐述了美国政府的政策……

sentences.en: I understand the declaration.
sentences.zh: 我明白那份声明。

sentences.en: I welcome it.
sentences.zh: 我欢迎它。

sentences.en: I'm glad that it seems like we had to do a lot of effort to get there.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴，看来我们得费很大劲才能达成这一点。

sentences.en: But the question is, when he had a chance, did he confront Putin and say, hey, we don't recognize your annexation of Crimea.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，当他有机会时，他有没有当面质问普京，说“嘿，我们不承认你对克里米亚的吞并”。

sentences.en: We don't recognize your continuing hostilities in eastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: “我们不承认你在乌克兰东部持续的敌对行动”。

sentences.en: And there's consequences for that.
sentences.zh: “而且这会有后果”。

sentences.en: Senator, the president was very clear with Vladimir Putin about U.S.
sentences.zh: 参议员，总统对弗拉基米尔·普京非常明确地表达了美国的

sentences.en: positions.
sentences.zh: 立场。

sentences.en: They're the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那些就是美国的

sentences.en: positions that are the Trump administration's positions.
sentences.zh: 立场，也就是特朗普政府的立场。

sentences.en: And he spoke about them very firmly and clearly when he met with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 他在与弗拉基米尔·普京会面时，非常坚定且明确地谈到了这些。

sentences.en: And he told you that?
sentences.zh: 他告诉过你这些？

sentences.en: Senator, I'm telling you what he had a conversation with Vladimir Putin about.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我是在告诉你他与弗拉基米尔·普京谈论了什么。

sentences.en: And I'm telling you what U.S.
sentences.zh: 我是在告诉你美国的

sentences.en: policy is today.
sentences.zh: 政策今天是什么。

sentences.en: Senator, I understand the game that you're playing.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我明白你在玩什么把戏。

sentences.en: No, you know, Mr. Secretary, with all due respect, I don't appreciate you characterizing my questions.
sentences.zh: 不，你知道，国务卿先生，恕我直言，我不喜欢你对我提问方式的定性。

sentences.en: My questions is to get to the truth.
sentences.zh: 我的提问是为了寻求真相。

sentences.en: We don't know what the truth is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道真相是什么。

sentences.en: And Menendez is just basically sticking to the brass tacks.
sentences.zh: 梅嫩德斯基本上是在坚持追问核心事实。

sentences.en: He's saying, I'm asking you, did he tell you?
sentences.zh: 他在说，我问你，他有没有告诉你？

sentences.en: And what did he tell you?
sentences.zh: 他到底告诉了你什么？

sentences.en: And Pompeo basically sort of dismisses it as a political ploy.
sentences.zh: 而蓬佩奥基本上把这当作一种政治策略给打发了。

sentences.en: And he just isn't answering the questions.
sentences.zh: 他就是不回答问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this felt like the common theme in this hearing.
